div.p: Aggregate route availability recovered from 98.1% to 99.2% after relay replacement, but East Junction still accounts for 14 of 19 resets. The four-zone sample masks one intermittently stale axle-counter channel; the overnight possession is a useful verification window but does not establish a durable repair.
